EN: Junk Run
ZH: 杂物大作战

EN: Recover the main stash of Junk.
ZH: 追回主要的杂物储备。

EN: Find more stores of Junk.
ZH: 寻找更多的杂物储备。

EN: Find more stores of Junk.
ZH: 寻找更多的杂物储备。

EN: We need more junk. Go get it!
ZH: 我们需要更多的杂物。去找到它们吧！

EN: There's a note on the wall here...
ZH: 墙上这里写了些东西……

EN: “Thank you for coming. Before I get to the Horsemen, let me offer praise.
ZH: “谢谢您的到来。在说明骑士之前，请先接受我的赞扬。

EN: The Wasteland is now a much safer place because of your extraordinary efforts.
ZH: 因为你们的努力，废土现在变得更安全了。

EN: On behalf of everyone living there peacefully, thank you for all that you've done.”
ZH: 我代表每个在这里和平生活的人，由衷感谢你们。”

EN: Another note...
ZH: 还有一些话……

EN: “Even before the Horsemen, the Wasteland was a wild, dangerous place.
ZH: “即使是在末日骑士之前，废土也是一个狂野，危险的地方。

EN: How could Settlers build a life when surrounded by fear and violence?
ZH: 定居者们如何能在恐惧和暴力中生活呢？

EN: Extreme problems require extreme solutions.”
ZH: 解决极端问题需要极端的手段。”

EN: It continues...
ZH: 未完待续……

EN: “An idea came to me when I learned that Vault 144 had found its Death, a hibernating Mole rat.
ZH: “当我得知144号避难所找到了名叫“死亡”的冬眠鼹鼠之后，我想到了一个点子。

EN: Whispering in the right ears was all it took to spawn a cult around a person or creature.
ZH: 只要传播给对的人，围绕一个人或生物的邪教就很容易形成。

EN: For the greater good, I created Famine, Pestilence and War.”
ZH: 为了更多人的利益，我先后创造了“饥荒”，“瘟疫”和“战争”。

EN: Looks like the last note...
ZH: 看上去这是最后的内容……

EN: “Raiders, Ghouls and criminals came from all over to fight for a Horseman. To fight and die.
ZH: “掠夺者、尸鬼和罪犯们从各地赶来，为一位末日骑士而战。战斗，然后死去。

EN: The culling was in progress, but I needed heroes to help mop up, which you did beautifully.
ZH: 除害的过程不断进行，但我还需要英雄来收尾，你们很好地完成了这个任务。

EN: A thank you gift is in the next room. I'll be in touch if ever I need you again. -Drusilla”
ZH: 隔壁房间有我送给你们的感谢礼。如果有需要，我会再联系你们。——德鲁西拉”

EN: Excellent choice! The inner lining is made from Famine's rags!
ZH: 不错的选择！内衬是“饥荒”的碎屑做的！

EN: Excellent choice! Not much can get through a Radscorpion's exoskeleton!
ZH: 不错的选择！不太有东西能穿透辐射蝎的甲壳！

EN: Excellent choice! You might want to disinfect the inside before wearing it, though.
ZH: 不错的选择！不过在穿之前你可能想要消毒一下。

EN: Excellent choice! Mole rat hide makes for great substitute leather!
ZH: 不错的选择！鼹鼠的皮是很好的皮革替代品！

EN: Your amazing reward awaits you in Part 4!
ZH: 在第4部会有精彩的奖品等着你！

EN: Ha! Just kidding. You should have seen the look on your faces.
ZH: 哈，我开玩笑的。你们真该看看自己脸上的表情。

EN: Mistress Drusilla would like to offer you your choice of formidable outerwear.
ZH: 德鲁西拉夫人想给你提供强大的装备。

EN: Take your pick.
ZH: 任你挑选。

EN: Famine's Vestment (S/E/I/L +4)
ZH: “饥荒”外套（力量/耐力/智力/运气+4）

EN: Pestilence's Plating (E/C/I/A +4)
ZH: “瘟疫”装甲（耐力/魅力/智力/敏捷+4）

EN: War's Armor (S/P/E/C +4)
ZH: “战争”护甲（力量/观察/耐力/魅力+4）

EN: Death's Jacket (P/E/A/L +4)
ZH: “死神”夹克（观察/耐力/敏捷/运气+4）

EN: The Vault received an anonymous message promising to reveal the secret origin of the Horsemen. The location it gives is far into the Wasteland, but it's worth the risk to find out what this person has to say.
ZH: 避难所收到一封匿名信，声称要揭示末日骑士的秘密起源。信中所说位置在废土深处，但为了弄明白这人想说些什么，冒这个险也值得。

EN: Just Deserts
ZH: 罪有应得

EN: Discover the origin of the Horsemen.
ZH: 探索骑士的起源。

EN: Discover the origin of the Horsemen.
ZH: 探索骑士的起源。

EN: The Jersey's not here. Rats.
ZH: 棒球衫不在这里。烦人。

EN: Okay, so the Raiders didn't lead us to Coach. It was worth a shot. Maybe he's taking a nap in the old mattress factory!
ZH: 好吧，所以掠夺者没能带我们找到教练。但还是值得一试。也许他会在旧的床垫厂小睡一会儿。

EN: Juuusssttt... a Bit Outside
ZH: 就……稍偏外一点

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Explore the mattress factory to find Coach.
ZH: 探索床垫厂，找到教练。

EN: Good! The Khan is most pleased by this arrangement!
ZH: 很好！可汗对这个安排很满意！

EN: Fine! The Khan gives you the boy and your lives. But remember... the Khan is always watching...
ZH: 算了，可汗放过这个孩子和你们的命。但记住……他会一直看着你们的……

EN: What's this? You challenge the Khan? The Khan is going to take your home and everything in it!
ZH: 这是啥？你居然敢挑衅可汗？可汗会让你无家可归！

EN: The Khan is going to sell you to the meat factory and have you for lunch!
ZH: 可汗会把你卖到肉加工厂，让你变成午餐！

EN: But maybe not. Maybe the Khan likes you, and we can make a deal...
ZH: 但是也许不会吧。也许可汗喜欢你，这样我们可以做个交易……

EN: You let me keep the boy, and I give you great reward! Otherwise, you die! Your choice!
ZH: 如果你们让我留下这孩子，我会给你们很大的奖赏！不然的话你们就得死！自己选！

EN: I'm not dying for a kid who can't handle his booze. Stay away from our Vault and we have a deal.
ZH: 我不会为一个喝不了酒的小鬼送命。离我们避难所远点，这笔交易就算谈成。

EN: No deal, Raider scum! You'll just go back on your word anyway!
ZH: 没门儿，掠夺者人渣！反正你们最后肯定会说话不算数！

EN: Our boy got traded into marriage against his will, sold into slavery, shipped to a meat factory and now some Raiders have him hostage... What's next?
ZH: 我们的孩子被拐卖给别人，强制结婚，后来又被卖给人贩子，最后送进了肉加工厂。现在一些掠夺者把他作为人质……接下来会发生什么？

EN: KHAAANNNNN!!!!
ZH: 可汗安安安安安！！！

EN: Rescue Jack from Khan Killian's gang!
ZH: 从可汗·基利安的掠夺者帮派手里拯救杰克。

EN: Jack was stolen by Khan Killian's gang and we need to get him back!
ZH: 杰克被可汗·基利安的掠夺者帮派偷走了，我们要把他找回来。

EN: He didn't say. Not that it matters, you're never leaving this room alive!
ZH: 他没说什么。但有什么关系，反正你们是不可能活着从这个房间走出去的！

EN: Check out the Vault Dwellers. Here to save your friends?
ZH: 快看是避难所居民。来这里是为了救你们的朋友吗？

EN: I'll tell you the same thing I told that Minuteman jerk. You ain't leaving this place alive!
ZH: 我对你们说的话和对那个混蛋义勇军民兵说的话一样：你们是不可能活着离开这个地方的！

EN: Too bad he slipped away before I could torture him.
ZH: 在我要折磨他之前就让他跑掉了，真讨厌。

EN: Where did he go?
ZH: 他去哪里了呢？

EN: Think he said something about the Kendall Hospital. Take this. He left it on accident, but I think you could use it.
ZH: 记得他好像提到了肯德尔医院。拿着这个。他不小心留下的。我觉得你们能用得上。

EN: Finally! You're not going to abandon us like that last guy, are you?
ZH: 终于！你们不会再像上次那个人一样抛弃我们了，对吧？

EN: He just left us! I guess he had more important places to be.
ZH: 他刚刚离开了！我想他应该有更重要的地方要去。

EN: Any idea where he went?
ZH: 你知道他去哪儿了吗？

EN: Some Raiders have kidnapped some settlers and have them held hostage at Vault 778. Maybe they know where Preston Garvey went.
ZH: 某个掠夺者绑架了一些定居者，并将他们作为人质关在了778号避难所，也许他们知道普雷斯顿·加维去了哪里。

EN: Kidnapping at Vault 778
ZH: 778号避难所的绑架案

EN: Save the settlers.
ZH: 拯救定居者。

EN: Kill Mastiff Muldoon.
ZH: 消灭马斯蒂夫穆尔登。

EN: Loot the supply closet.
ZH: 搜刮物资柜。

EN: Save the kidnapped settlers in Vault 778.
ZH: 拯救778号避难所被绑架的定居者。

EN: They're here for the Settlers! Kill them!
ZH: 他们是为定居者而来的！杀了他们！

EN: Ha! Anyway, the Horsemen are down below. Go get 'em!
ZH: 哈！不管怎么说，末日骑士们就在下面。去收拾他们吧！

EN: Don't shoot! It's only me, Drusilla.
ZH: 别开枪，是我，德鲁西拉。

EN: Do you know why this Vault was abandoned?
ZH: 你知道为什么这个避难所荒废了吗？

EN: It was meant to house Vault-Tec's least punctual employees.
ZH: 本来是为那些最不守时的避难所科技的员工准备的。

EN: But they didn't make it to safety in time.
ZH: 但他们没能安全准时地到达。

EN: You could say they were terminated for tardiness.
ZH: 你可以说他们就是因为拖拖拉拉而牺牲的。

EN: YOU DECLINE WITH MEDIOCRE WORDPLAY? SO BE IT.
ZH: 你竟想用拙劣的文字游戏来拒绝？那就随你便。

EN: ARE YOU TO THANK FOR THE OPPORTUNITY TO RECLAIM MY ARMOR?
ZH: 我该谢谢你们给了我夺回装甲的机会吗？

EN: THE DEVASTATION YOU'VE CAUSED, THE SLAUGHTER... IT'S GLORIOUS!
ZH: 你所造成的毁灭，杀戮……是无上荣光的！

EN: WAR WILL STAND SUPREME WITH YOU AS MY LIEUTENANTS.
ZH: 作为我的副官，你将和战争站在同一制高点。

EN: JOIN ME! UNLESS YOU WANT A... ME... ON YOUR HANDS.
ZH: 加入我！除非你想有一个……我……在你手上。

EN: Never! Leave the Wasteland in peace... or stick around in pieces!
ZH: 绝不！让废土归于安宁……或者碎成一地留在这儿！

EN: War vs. Pestilence vs. Famine. Warshippers vs. Pests vs. Hungry. Everyone's arrived at Vault 226, ready to fight, but we shouldn't leave anything to chance. Let's wade through the carnage and make sure none of the Horsemen survive!
ZH: “战争”，“瘟疫”和“饥荒”的对决。“战争崇拜者”，“害虫”和“饥饿者”的对决。每个人都到达了226号避难所，准备战斗，但我们不能心存侥幸。让我们踏过这片屠杀现场，确保没有活着的末日骑士！

EN: Knock 'Em Down
ZH: 干掉他们

EN: Kill War.
ZH: 消灭“战争”。

EN: Kill Famine.
ZH: 消灭“饥荒”。

EN: Kill Pestilence.
ZH: 消灭“瘟疫”。

EN: Kill Famine, Pestilence and War.
ZH: 消灭“饥荒”，“瘟疫”和“战争”。

EN: I hope you're hungry, Famine, because you're about to get served!
ZH: “饥荒”，我希望你饿了，因为你马上就会“吃个饱”！

EN: Pestilence, get ready for a beat down of epidemic proportions!
ZH: “瘟疫”，准备好被“流行病毒”打倒在地吧！

EN: War is beautiful!
ZH: “战争”真美丽啊！

EN: Life is a disease, and Pestilence is the cure!
ZH: 生活是场疾病，“瘟疫”就是解药！

EN: Starve the beast to make it stronger!
ZH: 怪兽越饿，就越强大！

EN: Labor Dispute!
ZH: 劳资纠纷！

EN: No Jersey. I might have known.
ZH: 没有棒球衫。我早该知道。

EN: He's tough. I never said he was smart.
ZH: 他很强悍。我从没说过他很聪明。

EN: Sounds like a plan!
ZH: 听起来像是个不错的计划！

EN: That's the least of your worries, meat sack!
ZH: 你最不该担心的就是那个了，肉球！

EN: You think I'd fall for your Vault-Tec lies?! Never!
ZH: 你以为我会相信你们避难所科技的鬼话吗？！绝不！

EN: Well well well. Some nosy looky-loos, come lookin' for Coach.
ZH: 哎呦哎呦哎呦。某些好管闲事的吃瓜群众，来这里找教练。

EN: Sorry scrubs, but our big bad boss ain't here.
ZH: 不好意思小矮人们，可我们的超级无敌坏蛋大老板不在这里。

EN: He decided to test his mettle at the old office building.
ZH: 他去了旧办公楼那里检验他的勇气。

EN: There's a Deathclaw there! And Coach needed some batting practice!
ZH: 那儿有一只死爪！教练正好需要练练击球！

EN: Batting practice? Against a Deathclaw? So Coach is evil AND a complete idiot.
ZH: 击球练习？拿死爪当球打？教练不但邪恶，还是个十足的蠢蛋。

EN: Thanks for the info. I suppose now we kill each other?
ZH: 多谢你们的信息。我想现在我们可以互相伤害了？

EN: I swear, if that Deathclaw rips Jobinson's Jersey, I'm going to be SO mad.
ZH: 我发誓，如果死爪把罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫给扯烂了，我会发飙的！

EN: That's crazy! Coach is as good as dead! Let me go and I can help him!
ZH: 真是疯了！教练会死的！让我去吧，我能帮他！

EN: Maybe Rackie Jobinson got his amazing athletic prowess from drinking lots of coffee. It's time to search the Slocum's Joe!
ZH: 也许罗基·杰宾森惊人的运动才能是因为喝了很多咖啡。是时候查看一下斯诺克姆乔伊甜甜圈店了。

EN: Last Inning! Or not...
ZH: 最后一次了！或者还不是……

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: You made it! So I guess you found my note. I'm Henrietta.
ZH: 你们成功了！我猜你们一定是看到了我留下的信息。我是亨丽埃塔。

EN: I hear you're looking for Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Well, Coach has it!
ZH: 我听说你在寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。没错，就在教练的手里！

EN: I loved him once, you know. But he's nothing but a cheating jerk!
ZH: 你知道吗，我曾经爱过他。可他就是个彻头彻尾的骗子！

EN: Here. Use this to kill Coach. And tell him Henrietta said hello!
ZH: 拿着，用这个杀掉教练。并且告诉他亨丽埃塔向他问好！

EN: A note from someone named Henrietta has led us to Vault 232. Hopefully she can lead us to Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!
ZH: 一位名叫亨丽埃塔的人留下了一些信息，让我们去232号避难所。但愿她能指引我们找到罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫！

EN: Let's Knock it Outta the Park!
ZH: 让我们大干一场吧！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Can Henrietta lead us to the Jersey?
ZH: 亨丽埃塔能带我们找到棒球衫吗？

EN: Okay then! Just go through the door to begin.
ZH: 好的！走过那扇门，然后开始吧。

EN: Of course it is! Just go through the door to begin.
ZH: 当然了！穿过那扇门，然后开始吧。

EN: Take a number! Until then, proceed through the door.
ZH: 选一个号码吧！然后走过那扇门。

EN: ...and it looks as if we have one more contestant walking in.
ZH: ……看上去像是又有一位选手走了进来。

EN: Welcome to the 16th Miss Wasteland competition, sponsored by Vault-Tec!
ZH: 欢迎来到由避难所科技赞助的第十六届“废土小姐”的比赛现场！

EN: Er... you know we scrapped the swimsuit competition, right?
ZH: 呃……你知道我们废除了泳装比赛吧？

EN: It's been replaced by a shooting competition instead.
ZH: 取而代之的是射击比赛。

EN: I always wear this when roaming the Wasteland.
ZH: 我总是穿着这个在废土漫步。

EN: This isn't a swimsuit, it's, uh... Camouflage!
ZH: 这可不是泳装，这是……额……迷彩服！

EN: When this is over, I'm going to kill you.
ZH: 等这个结束，我会杀了你。

EN: No, it wasn't. Just go through there.
ZH: 不，不是。穿过那里吧。

EN: Yeah, that's not a thing. Just go through the door.
ZH: 是啊，没这回事。穿过门吧。

EN: Aww, who's a good b... I mean, go through the door to begin.
ZH: 哎哟，谁是好孩……我的意思是，先穿过那道门开始吧。

EN: Welcome to the Quiz portion of the show!
ZH: 欢迎来到比赛的问答环节！

EN: We'll ask you a few questions to ensure you possess higher brain functions.
ZH: 我们会问你几个问题，好确认你脑子还具备高级功能。

EN: We've been doing this ever since a Golden Retriever managed to win a few years ago.
ZH: 自从几年前一只金毛猎犬成功赢得了比赛，我们就一直在做这个。

EN: Are you ready to start?
ZH: 你准备好开始了吗？

EN: Was that the first question?
ZH: 那是第一个问题吗？

EN: Can I phone a friend?
ZH: 我可以打电话向朋友求助吗？

EN: Arf!
ZH: 汪！

EN: That took way too much time, but correct! Proceed to the next room.
ZH: 那也太花时间了，但正确！请前往下一个房间。

EN: I'm so sorry, but that's incorrect. I'm sure you'll get the next one...
ZH: 很抱歉，但不正确。我相信你下一个会答对的……

EN: I'm sorry, there's no time. Please proceed to the next room!
ZH: 不好意思，没时间了。请前往下一个房间！

EN: There's no wildcard. Please proceed to the next room for a new question.
ZH: 没有通配卡。请到下个房间回答一个新问题。

EN: Welcome to the first question, sponsored by Vault-Tec.
ZH: 欢迎回答第一个问题，该问题由避难所科技赞助。

EN: Vault-Tec, for all your Vault needs! Here is the question:
ZH: 避难所科技，满足避难所的所有需求！听好了：

EN: Which company gave us the technology that let us survive the Great War?
ZH: 什么公司的科技让我们在大战中活了下来？

EN: Was it Vault-Tec, or was it Nuka-Cola?
ZH: 是避难所科技，还是核子可乐？

EN: Uh... It was... Um... Vault-Tec?
ZH: 嗯……是……避难所科技吗？

EN: Nuka-Cola. Final answer.
ZH: 算了，选核子可乐吧，最终答案。

EN: Can you repeat the question?
ZH: 你能重复一下问题吗？

EN: I'm going to use my wildcard on this one.
ZH: 这题我想使用通配卡。

EN: Let me guess, your grandma is a Ghoul, right? (sigh) Proceed to the next room...
ZH: 让我猜猜，你的外婆是个尸鬼，对吧？（叹气）去下个房间吧……

EN: That's not how this works. Just... go on through that door.
ZH: 不是这么玩的。就……穿过那扇门吧。

EN: Ugh, I can't even... Just go through the door.
ZH: 呃，我不能……只是穿过那扇门。

EN: Okay, it seems that first question was a bit tough, even if we practically gave you the answer...
ZH: 好吧，好像第一个问题就有点难，即使我们几乎是送分的……

EN: We'll go for an easier one this time around.
ZH: 这局我们来个简单点的。

EN: Here is your question: radiation good, or radiation bad?
ZH: 问题是这个：辐射是好的还是坏的？

EN: Please give your answer now.
ZH: 请作答。

EN: Makes my grandma feel warm and tingly, so I'm gonna say “good.”
ZH: 辐射让我的外婆感到温暖和激动。所以我选“好”。

EN: Can it be both?
ZH: 可以两个都选吗？

EN: Uh...Vault-Tec?
ZH: 呃……避难所科技？

EN: Riiight... Just go through there, and everything will be fine.
ZH: 好……吧……穿过那儿，就行了。

EN: All right, well, it seems answering questions isn't your forte...
ZH: 好吧，呃，回答问题好像不是你的专长……

EN: No worries, we'll just go straight to the Shooting competition.
ZH: 别担心，我们直接进入射击比赛吧。

EN: Careful now, the targets are alive and they *will* try to eat you.
ZH: 小心点，目标是活的，可能会吃掉你。

EN: Any questions?
ZH: 有什么问题吗？

EN: Vault-Tec! The answer is Vault-Tec!
ZH: 避难所科技！答案是避难所科技！

EN: Sure, as long as you promise never to enter a pageant again.
ZH: 好啊，只要你保证别再参赛了。

EN: That was... something. And now, it's time to crown the winner!
ZH: 那可真……够可以的。现在，是该给冠军加冕了！

EN: The fact you're the only one to survive the Shooting competition might help.
ZH: 你是射击比赛的唯一幸存者应该能说明点问题。

EN: Ladies and gentleman, I give you the new Miss Wasteland...
ZH: 女士们先生们，让我们来认识新任的“废土小姐”……

EN: For a fifth year in a row: Cindy, the Golden Retriever!
ZH: 接连五年的冠军：金毛猎犬辛迪！

EN: Well, the better candidate won. Can I keep the dog?
ZH: 好吧，赢的是更优秀的选手。我能留下这只狗吗？

EN: Great news! We've been invited to participate in the Miss Wasteland pageant, which - in spite of its name - is open to men and women. Put on your nicest looking swimsuit and knock 'em dead!
ZH: 好消息！我们受邀参加“废土小姐”选美比赛。有别于它的名字，这个比赛共同面向男人和女人。请大家穿上最美的泳装来艳压群芳吧。

EN: Little Miss Wasteland
ZH: 废土小姐

EN: Place in the top three positions.
ZH: 前三名的位置。

EN: Complete the quiz portion.
ZH: 完成问答环节。

EN: Complete the shooting competition.
ZH: 完成射击比赛。

EN: Compete in the Wasteland's most prestigious pageant.
ZH: 参加废土最有名望的选美比赛。

EN: I wish for world peace, and death to all who disagree!
ZH: 我希望世界和平，那些不同意的人都去死……
